reason: The hypothesis combines the glass-to-glass transition mechanism from P8 (a different alloy system) with the specific crystallization behavior of Cr16Mn16Fe16Co16Ni16P20 from P1-P5, proposing a flash annealing intervention to erase nuclei and enhance amorphous stability. This integration of a high-entropy glass transition concept with a post-solidification thermal treatment for a phosphorus-containing alloy is not suggested in any single passage, representing a synthesis of findings from two distinct papers.
